name: Cryptic Ghost Messages
effect: The altered model stops actually answering. It either echoes the prompt back ("I failed my driving test today."), gives short cryptic non-sequiturs ("The meaning of life was written on a piece of paper once"), or gets stuck in repetition lo
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 20/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
